method: Same-agent English/Marathi block-by-block close reading, reverse reconstruction of the introductory semantic and proof-theoretic examples, replay of the ant/insect entailment, and exact formula, macro, controlled-token, citation, identifier and reference comparison after documented OLFOL-001 projection. No independent human or native-speaker review is claimed.
scope: The introductory characterization of first-order logic as a formal language, its central semantic questions, structures and satisfaction, derivation systems, and the metalogical connection between syntax and semantics.

samples.reverse_paraphrase: First-order or quantificational/predicate logic is a formal language whose vocabulary forms permitted strings classified as terms, formulas and sentences. Its sentences support questions of consequence, logical truth or falsity, contingency and equivalence.
samples.checks: The prior-knowledge qualification and footnote, alternate names, vocabulary/string distinction, three expression kinds and all three example questions are retained.

samples.reverse_paraphrase: Semantics replaces an intuitive case with a mathematically precise structure and defines satisfaction, allowing exact definitions of consequence and logical truth. The universal and existential premises entail an existential conclusion, matching the valid ants-and-insects argument.
samples.checks: Truth and falsity countercase analysis, structure, satisfaction notation, entailment formula, symbolization example and validity conclusion are preserved; OLFOL-001 only balances the frozen brackets.

samples.reverse_paraphrase: Derivations can be given by natural deduction, truth trees and other systems. A derivation with the universal and existential premises and existential conclusion verifies the example entailment.
samples.checks: Course context, plurality of systems, tool-giving purpose, both premises, conclusion, final-line role and verification claim remain exact.

samples.reverse_paraphrase: Formal derivations only arrange symbols under rules and do not themselves mention cases or truth. A metalogical proof must establish that the displayed derivation exists exactly when its premises semantically entail its conclusion, after syntax and semantics are defined carefully.
samples.checks: The syntactic/semantic contrast, biconditional strength, repeated premises and conclusion, mathematical-proof requirement and prerequisite definitional work are all retained.

source_observations: The source repeats one elementary entailment three times with malformed square-bracket placement; OLFOL-001 makes every occurrence the same well-formed two-premise entailment and documents the change adjacent to the first occurrence.
The target distinguishes the intuitive semantic प्रसंग from the formal !!{structure} while using the established पूर्ति, तार्किक निष्पन्नता, वैधता, विन्यासमीमांसा and चिन्हार्थमीमांसा vocabulary.
All formulas, glossary tokens, citations, macros, identifiers and references match the frozen source after the unit-specific correction projection.
limitations: No independent human or native-speaker review has been performed.
आकारिक भाषा and आकारिक निष्पत्ती follow direct official evidence for आकारिक plus established component terms; decision T202 remains expert-reviewable.
The section motivates rather than formally defines the semantic and proof-theoretic notions developed in later units.
